title: Steal our 8 figure KPI system we use to scale
description: Steal our 8 figure KPI system we use to scale
transcript: Typically the way you want to distribute KPIs in your company is you want to start at the very top and you want to slowly go down. KPI for your media director could be number of unique reach you're getting a month. So that graphic designer is thinking, how do I make a quote that gets me more unique reach for our department so that we can help the overall company. KPI, which is new cat, we're at the level now where CEO has it, the directors have it, and then the layer below them has it as well. For our short form editors, it's number of shorts posted a day. That's the KPI for them, which leads to the media buying KPI, which is unique organic reach, which leads to the marketing KPI, which is organic booked calls, which leads to the company KPI, which is new cash coming in. And that's how you make sure everyone's rowing the same direction.
